shortDescription: The German Monday baseload power contract reached €223 ($258.86) per megawatt hour at 0743 on Friday as wind and solar power generation is expected to fall further at the start of next week.The German spot price is already high for the season as elevated gas prices drive up the cost of electricity…

children: The German Monday baseload power contract reached €223 ($258.86) per megawatt hour at 0743 on Friday as wind and solar power generation is expected to fall further at the start of next week.
The German spot price is already high for the season as elevated gas prices drive up the cost of electricity.
